#!/bin/bash
# Check that the CI workflow includes both build steps added by PR #20
if grep -q "npm run build:ts" .github/workflows/ci.yml && grep -q "npm run build:skill" .github/workflows/ci.yml; then
    echo "PASS: Both build steps are present in CI workflow"
    exit 0
else
    echo "FAIL: Missing build steps in CI workflow"
    exit 1
fi
